cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: A compact planetarium lobby beside a bench made of dark glass and a miniature orbital map — She pauses on her way to the morning show and opens a little ticket envelope to check her seat; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A public ferry pavilion with pale stone benches and a clear view of the harbour at golden hour — She pauses to watch projected sea charts before departure; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — holds a sketchbook and pencil out at arm's length to look over the finished sketch; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — chest-deep in the water; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a second-hand book stall under an awning on a quiet street — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — lying on her front; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — lying on her front; a Peking opera dressing room — standing close to a high shelf or line; a hotel suite with a city view and an open suitcase — holds her keepsake up beside her face
